title: filago germanica subsp. eriocephala
intro: Filago germanica subsp. eriocephala, commonly known as German false fleabane, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of German false fleabane include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The plant's bioactive constituents contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions, including infections, wounds, and inflammatory diseases.
